While wielding a one-handed weapon, your attack speed is increased by {attack_speed_pct} and all cooldowns are reduced by {cooldown_reduction_pct}. | Unlocked at level 10. | "As the wicked fall at your feet, you shall know the power of the crusade."—Sir Gyrfalcon the Swift

Increase Life regeneration by {heal_per_second_life}. | Reduce all non-Physical damage taken by {damage_reduction_pct}. | Unlocked at level 13. | "May Akarat protect me and grant me the faith to allow the Light to heal my soul."—The Crusader's Oath
Your primary skills generate an additional {generated_resource} Wrath. | Increase maximum Wrath by {max_pool_resource}. | Unlocked at level 16. | The deeper your belief, the greater your power.
Blocking an attack generates {gain_resource} Wrath. | Unlocked at level 20. | Tenacity is measured by one's endurance against overwhelming odds.

Increase the attack speed of Punish, Slash, Smite and Justice by {attack_speed_pct}. | Unlocked at level 20. | "My words are not new. The ancients embraced the Light completely, and it made them mightier than we can even imagine."—Akarat

When you receive fatal damage, you instead become immune to damage, gain {damage_bonus_pct} increased damage and gain {heal_per_hit_life} Life per Kill for {duration_seconds} seconds. | This effect may occur once every {internal_cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 25. | "As my life drained away, I could no longer feel the blows raining down upon me."—Anajinn

The amount of damage dealt by your weapon is increased by {damage_bonus_pct}. | Whenever you deal Holy damage, you heal up to {heal_pct} of your total Life. | Unlocked at level 27. | "Unleash your might upon the wicked that they may be cleansed."—Melmoth, the Wanderer of the Wastes

Each point of Wrath spent heals you for {heal_per_hit_life} Life. | Heal amount is increased by {healing_bonus_share_pct} of your Health Globe Healing Bonus. | Unlocked at level 30. | "One clad in the Light absorbs the anger of her foes and then turns it against them."—Crusader saying

Your Armor is increased by a percent equal to your shield's Block Chance. | Unlocked at level 30. | "His shield whirled around him, faster than the eye could follow, creating an impenetrable barrier against his foes."—The Tale of Joryn

The cooldown of Steed Charge is reduced by {cooldown_reduction_pct:steed_charge} and Bombardment by {cooldown_reduction_pct:bombardment}. | Damage dealt by Phalanx is increased {damage_bonus_pct}. | Unlocked at level 35. | "You will follow, or you will fall."—Kassar
You can no longer Dodge, but your Block Chance is increased by {block_pct}. | Unlocked at level 40. | "I shall not be moved. Your blows cannot touch me."—Harrel the Unbreakable

Increase the duration of the Active effect of all Laws by {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 45. | "The Light sustains the law, for without it, the law is naught but empty words"—Cleric Akkhan
Your Thorns is increased by {thorns_pct}. | Unlocked at level 50. | Woe to those who would approach a true crusader while carrying anger in their hearts, for soon, they shall be no more.

Whenever you successfully block, you gain {heal_life} Life. | Unlocked at level 55. | "I say unto you, let not the foul darkness engulf the Light within you. For whosoever hears these words and knows them to be true shall be reborn."—Akarat
Gain {primary_stat_pct} Strength for every gem socketed into your gear. | Unlocked at level 60. | As you meditate upon those stones that contain the Light, you will find the Light within yourself.
Increase the damage of Justice and Blessed Hammer by {damage_bonus_pct}. | Unlocked at level 65. | Let your hammer educate the heathens in the error of their ways.

Increase the damage of Punish, Shield Bash and Blessed Shield by {damage_bonus_pct}. | Reduce the cooldown of Shield Glare by {cooldown_reduction_pct}. | Unlocked at level 70. | A crusader's shield is one with his body.
